actions.name: Use
actions.area: Allies, enemies, and self within a 60-ft.-radius centered on you

description.summary: The caster emulates a Hecteyes by summoning a hand of death that cycles through your allies, yourself, and your foes alike
description.value: The caster emulates a Hecteyes by summoning a hand of death that cycles through your allies, yourself, and your foes alike. Choose a creature within 60 feet at random, that creature dies. This spell cannot be reflected back at the caster. Everyone’s numbers must be decided before you make the roll. Roll a die based on the size of the group within the radius and if it happens on fall upon their number, that target dies. If the number happens to be in between two picked numbers, flip a coin to determines who dies. Learned From Ahriman, Hecteyes or Orukat
